name: Katou Neko
source:
The only child in a wealthy family. Although her family life seems perfect at first, she grew in a slightly complicated environment with a father who is indifferent towards his family and a mother who was dependent on her daughter. At the age of five, she joined an entertainment agency at the request of her mother, who dreamed of becoming an entertainer when she was younger. She was active in magazine and local commercials for teens, but since her height was sluggish, she turned into an actress and is currently studying acting.

Although she is friendly, she has a thick wall in her heart and keeps a distance from everyone. She's lazy at her own pace. Her words are often refreshing yet poisonous.

[Translated from [url=https://saya-sp.com/hanasaya_gp_op/layer_if/layer_ifb_character/]official website[/url]]
